title: DIGEST: Discovery-Guided LLM Tuning for Symbolic Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.33880v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks to discover mathematical expressions directly from data, without requiring task-specific scientific descriptions. Despite tremendous progress in both conventional search-based methods and recent LLM-based methods, two critical limitations largely remain. First (Limited Generation Flexibility), conventional search-based methods rely on either fixed search rules or specialized learned generators, severely limiting adaptive candidate generation across diverse expression structures. Second (Underutilized Search Discoveries), most LLM-based methods cannot reliably recover ground-truth expressions because they fall short in effectively leveraging the LLM itself to thoroughly digest past expressions or adaptively guide future search. translated_title: DIGEST：面向符号回归的发现引导式大语言模型调优
translated_abstract: 符号回归旨在直接从数据中发现数学表达式，而无需依赖任务特定的科学描述。尽管传统的基于搜索的方法和近年来基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法都取得了巨大进展，但仍存在两个关键局限。其一是生成灵活性受限：传统基于搜索的方法依赖于固定的搜索规则或专门训练的生成器，严重限制了在不同表达式结构间进行自适应候选生成的能力。其二是搜索发现利用不足：大多数基于LLM的方法无法可靠地恢复真值表达式，原因在于它们未能有效利用LLM本身来充分消化过去的表达式，或自适应地引导未来的搜索。为解决这些局限，我们提出了DIGEST。为了实现更大的生成灵活性，DIGEST将轻量级LLM中预训练的解码器模块改造为符号策略……
tldr: DIGEST通过将预训练LLM的解码器模块改造为灵活的符号策略生成器，并有效消化和利用历史搜索发现来引导后续搜索，从而显著提升符号回归中恢复真值数学表达式的能力。
en_tdlr: DIGEST repurposes a pretrained LLM decoder into a flexible symbolic policy generator while effectively digesting past search discoveries to guide future search, thereby improving the reliable recovery of ground-truth expressions in symbolic regression.
